title: GET /api/v1/authenticated/me, 200
description: MeController#index, me_controller.rb lines 9-27. trust_factor carries the raw level for a verified, confidential OAuth application and the masked public level for any other, so only verified confidential apps can see yellow.

id.description: Hackatime's numeric user id. Stardance keeps it as a string (stardance hackatime_service.rb line 15).

emails.description: Every address on the account, or [] when there are none.

trust_factor.description: A level and its enum value from User.trust_levels (user.rb lines 48-53). The pair always agrees.
